## Error handler
Runs whenever a workflow with errorWorkflow set to this one fails. Loads context for config.team_email, composes a plain-text alert in config.team_locale's language (Compose error email, generated from src/nodes/compose-error-email.ts; an invalid team_locale still sends, in English), and emails it. This workflow has no errorWorkflow of its own, so a failure here does not loop back into itself.
